findings.actual_failure: An identical rerun at the same HEAD refuses denied-envelope-exists instead of exiting 0 without writing.
findings.observation: The stored proof-run envelope writes command, stdout and stderr with ensure_ascii, so a 1 MiB input with control or non-ASCII bytes grows the file past the 4 MiB bound the identical-rerun re-read uses.
findings.reachable_path: evidence-gate.py proof-run -> _store_envelope re-read of an existing envelope

findings.actual_failure: AC-0033 cannot be checked as written while the refusal criteria it overlaps are honoured.
findings.observation: AC-0033 requires every covered test to record at least one launch, while the AC-0011, AC-0012 and AC-0027 refusal tests must launch nothing and opt out with may_be_empty.

findings.actual_failure: A controller following the guidance from a subdirectory gets a refusal without a remedy.
findings.observation: evidence-gate.py refuses with a generic denied-git-control-state detail when run from a subdirectory, and the shipped guidance does not say to run it from the checkout root.

findings.actual_failure: A reader may misread a truncated list as complete at 51.
findings.observation: The shipped git-history subsection says the log is capped at 51, but the envelope reports at most 50 commits and uses a 51st only to mark truncation.

findings.actual_failure: A submodule-configured program runs inside proof-run, contrary to the rule that it launches only Git.
findings.observation: The proof-run dirty-tree check runs git status, which recurses into submodules whose own config can define a clean filter that HardenedGit does not neutralize, and proof-run skips the code-running-config refusal git-history applies.

findings.actual_failure: An input under .context/reviews/ is read and copied into an envelope on the default macOS file system, contrary to AC-0008.
findings.observation: The input-path exclusion compares the first part to reviews and proof-runs byte for byte, so on a case-insensitive file system .context/Reviews/... passes and the confined reader opens the review record.

findings.actual_failure: Deleting a branch of the consistency check stays green in the default lane.
findings.observation: check_proof_by_run is exercised only by integration-gated tests, so the default test lane never runs it.

findings.actual_failure: A refusal test can stay green with check_proof_by_run removed.
findings.observation: The T2 refusal tests assert only review-record-refused, which other later checks also raise, not the specific proof-run denial.

findings.actual_failure: A controller cannot tell which argument or condition caused the refusal.
findings.observation: proof-run maps every assessment, mutation, and input-read failure to one generic code and remedy, dropping the underlying denial.

findings.actual_failure: A regression could surface a traceback or leave a partial envelope unnoticed.
findings.observation: The denied-proof-run-invalid, denied-envelope-write, and SupervisorGitError refusal paths of proof-run have no test.

findings.actual_failure: Two mechanisms for one job.
findings.observation: evidence-gate.py keeps two separate caches for loading sibling modules once.

findings.actual_failure: Removing the identity refusal goes unseen on Linux CI.
findings.observation: The T11 default-lane unit test drives only the pure identity helper, so replacing its call in _input_file survives on a case-sensitive host where the integration tests skip.

findings.actual_failure: AC-0033 is unchecked for one covered test.
findings.observation: test_t12_helper_git_refusal_outside_a_repository_is_refused drives proof-run for AC-0008 without the launch spy, so AC-0033's launch check never runs for it.

findings.actual_failure: A repository-config program runs inside proof-run, contrary to the rule that it launches only Git.
findings.observation: proof-run does not refuse alternates, partial clone, or promisor object sources, so its first rev-parse can start a lazy fetch that runs a transport program named in repository config.

findings.actual_failure: The test stays green if that branch maps to the wrong code or another refusal fires first.
findings.observation: test_t12_helper_git_refusal_outside_a_repository_is_refused accepts any truthy refusal code instead of the helper-Git refusal code.

findings.actual_failure: Removing the type guard stays green while a non-string ref would crash the check with TypeError.
findings.observation: The check_proof_by_run outcome table has no single non-string reference row, which the type guard handles before schema validation.

findings.actual_failure: Dead optional path in a test helper.
findings.observation: The None branch of the _t12_assert_refused helper is never used.

findings.actual_failure: The security ordering guarantee lives only in the plan, so a later change could drop it without failing a criterion.
findings.observation: The proof-run object-source refusal and its before-any-launch ordering are contracted by no criterion; T14 cites AC-0007, and AC-0013 covers only git-history.

findings.actual_failure: A repository-config transport program runs inside git-history or proof-run.
findings.observation: The object-source refusal misses a remote with partialclonefilter, which Git treats as a promisor, so a lazy fetch can run remote.*.uploadpack from repository config.
findings.reachable_path: _git_history.refuse_object_sources -> cat-file -t / rev-parse on a missing object

findings.actual_failure: Any gap in the object-source check lets a configured program run.
findings.observation: Repository-scope transport and credential program keys (remote.*.uploadpack, remote.*.receivepack, credential helpers) are not refused, so the object-source check is the only barrier.

findings.actual_failure: A reader may take it as a zero-launch test.
findings.observation: test_t14_outside_object_source_is_refused_before_any_launch allows helper pinning and config launches, so its name overstates a zero-launch guarantee.

findings.actual_failure: A punctuation slip in criterion text; meaning unchanged.
findings.observation: AC-0034 joins two sentences with a comma before a capitalised The.
